title: S12T05 - Harden evidence command redaction and evidence-run capture
description: Operation argv redaction exists, but evidence records can still persist command text directly. Harden evidence command persistence and define the evidence-run boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Likely secrets in evidence command text are redacted or rejected unless explicitly allowed.
A bounded evidence-run command or equivalent artifact workflow captures exit code, hashes, and bounded logs without unbounded secret-bearing text.
closedReason: Evidence redaction and bounded capture boundary implemented and verified
